surveyMeta.description: An async side session for Britt and Aggie exploring the fairgrounds and boarding the VIP Airship Zephyr with Aunt Angela before the race.
surveyMeta.title: The Mizizi VIP Day
surveyMeta.name: The Mizizi VIP Day

blocks.content: You step out of the heavy wooden archway of Sterling Hall, the echoes of your last class fading behind you. The campus is buzzing, but before you can plan your next move, a colorful, eccentric figure ambushes you in the courtyard.

It is **Angela Galaspora** (Aunt Angela), laden with herbs, dangling satchels, and pockets bulging with botanical ingredients. She beams, adjusting a green leaf crown in her hair. Angela calls out to you:
"Hey girls! Just the Mizizi I was looking for. Come with me—we have a day ahead!"

ports.subtext: Sighing and looking at each other, you shrug. Knowing Aunt Angela is a force of nature.

blocks.content: Aunt Angela's gushing chatter fills the air as she herds you toward the university gates. Select your character to proceed.

ports.subtext: Re-evaluate the day from Britt's perspective.
Re-evaluate the day from Aggie's perspective.

blocks.content: As you match Aunt Angela's brisk stride, you feel a strange sensation—a sudden, subtle flutter in your chest, leaving you slightly woozy and out of breath. You attribute it to the dry city air and the stress of the upcoming exam, but you have to force yourself to focus.

You review your recent actions, trying to guess what might have drawn Aunt Angela out here. You think of your lost gold exam receipt taken by Azer's thugs in the dark alleyway, your arguments with Professor Silas Thorne over the hollow dead islands, and sneaking into Hangar 12 with Iggy and Ignatious. Whatever she wants, you'll have to play along.

ports.subtext: Follow Aunt Angela toward the berths.

blocks.content: Angela leads you through the university gates. Ahead, the grand marble pillars of **The Colonnade** frame a stunning view. Crisp white stone and polished brass fixtures catch the sunlight. Through the pillars, you look down into the basalt canyon of the **Apex Ring**.

The fairgrounds outside the canyon are packed. Banners of the racing teams flap in the breeze, and the air is filled with the high-pitched hum of next-gen batteries charging, the heavy thrum of engine blocks warming up, and the shouts of race fans carrying drinks from backpack dispensers.

ports.subtext: Roll Presence to see if you can keep your focus amidst the fair's chaos.

blocks.content: The Colonnade is alive with sights and sounds. The charge of ozone from the buzzing technology is thick. Roll Britt's Presence to see if she keeps her head clear despite her growing lightheadedness.

The fair is a blur of color and noise. You find yourself staring at a merchant gesturing frantically in absolute silence to sell banners, and carvers working on heavy basalt stones that float weightlessly above their tables. You lose yourself in the spectacle, failing to notice Angela's quiet movements.

ports.subtext: You catch up as Angela stops near the mooring ramp.

blocks.content: A bout of dizziness overcomes you as you find that you haven't heard a word Aggie and Angela have said since getting to the fair. Rubbing your head you see them both looking at you in worry, but you feel fine. Just a little tired so you don't say anything.

ports.subtext: Walk toward the mooring ramp.

blocks.content: You step onto the deck of the **Zephyr**. The ship is a marvel of Harmony weight-reduction science—warm mahogany wood, polished brass railings, and soft gaslight lanterns. The promenade deck wraps around a massive, circular glass floor looking down a mile into the basalt canyon of the Apex Ring.

Standing at the entryway are **Valentine Sterling Sr.**, the explorer you recognize from the short time he stayed with the Mizizi after discovering them. He is holding a notebook which has sketches of various vehicles on it and a map on the back. Next to him stands an Ash-blood you don't recognize. Angela gushes at them:

"Ah Mr. Cade, thank you thank you for arranging this adventure and pass my thanks along to Lady Ignis! Mr. Sterling, it is of course fantastic to see you again. I am so excited to see this ship fly and to learn about this Resy Race."

ports.subtext: Step forward with Angela.

blocks.content: Valentine Sterling Sr. greets you:
"Hello Elder Angela, welcome to the Zephyr, please note it is a Reso race not resy, but I am very excited for this season to begin—do you know any of the racers?"
Angela replies:
"Well I think our fellow Mycelium Circle member Rill had something to do with one of the teams, but honestly I forget which—wow look at these ferns...!"
As Sterling turns back toward the race chatter inside, leading you along, Cade Ashveil tries to fill the silence:
"Well these ferns are great, almost as cool as the rocks out in the race."

ports.text: Warn Cade she just cares about plants
ports.subtext: Interject to help Cade navigate Angela's plant obsession.

ports.text: Discuss how the ferns make great cover for racers
ports.subtext: Pitch a tactical thought about track foliage.

ports.text: Leave the diplomats to their small talk
ports.subtext: Excuse yourselves and head inside.

blocks.content: The passenger deck of the Zephyr is relaxed, with well-dressed servants carrying trays of food and drink moving among the guests. There are no enforcers patrolling here. You have time to look around before the starting horn sounds. What do you do?

ports.subtext: Check out Ludo and the staff.
Check the odds and place a bet with Valerius Sterling.

ports.text: Try to wave down Loami down in the stands
ports.subtext: You think you spot him carrying boxes of grog.

blocks.content: You lean over the copper railing and spot Loami's broad shoulders. He is actually on the same airship, carrying boxes of grog and arguing with a servant about selling furnace-grade 'Ambrosia of Luck' to the VIPs. You shout his name and push toward him.

But just as you get close, someone nearby starts cheering at a crawler launch. The spectator swings around to toast, thrusting a squirming, crying baby root-kin into your hands. Before you can react, you are patted on the back, toasted by a group of fans, and pulled into the cheering crowd.
By the time you hand the baby back and squeeze out of the crowd, Loami is gone. You'll have to find another way to pass the time.

ports.subtext: Choose another option.

blocks.content: Loami has vanished into the crowd. You still have time before the race begins. What do you do?

ports.subtext: Check out Ludo and the staff.
Check the odds and place a bet with Valerius Sterling.

blocks.content: You walk near the promenade bar. Leaning heavily against the mahogany counter is **Ludo Castellan**, Val Jr.'s enforcer and handler. He looks uncharacteristically relaxed, clutching a glass. Sticking out of his coat pocket, you spot the gold corner of an official Academy exam receipt.
When he spots you, he smiles:
"Ah, great you made it! That means I'm off duty—shots?"

ports.subtext: Finesse DC 13 to swipe the receipt.

ports.text: Get into a drinking match with Ludo
ports.subtext: Presence/Fortitude DC 12 to get him talking.

blocks.content: You carefully extend your fingers toward Ludo's pocket, waiting for him to take another drink to mask your movement.
You slip the receipt out of Ludo's pocket. You look at it and blink: **Ludo Castellan - GOLD RANK**. When Ludo notices you holding it, his face turns pale. He panics and whispers urgently:
"Give that back! Lyra can't know about this. She thinks I barely scraped by. Look, don't say a word to her, and we're good, alright? Please."

He downlines his shot of grog, grabs his jacket, and nervously walks away to watch the race. You realize he's hiding his Gold rank from his twin sister, and you get the distinct feeling that Lyra's own entrance exam did not go well. You have some serious leverage now.

ports.subtext: Go find Val Jr.

blocks.content: Ludo's hand snaps out, catching your wrist before you can grab the slip.
"Whoa there! I know I'm off duty, but hands off the merchandise. I buy my own drinks, and I keep my own keys."
He laughs it off, thinking you were trying to steal his glass, but he moves away to watch the race. Your heart hammers in your chest from the close call.

ports.subtext: Go find Val Jr.

blocks.content: You challenge Ludo to match you shot-for-shot of a heavy furnace-grog. Roll Fortitude/Presence to see if you can keep your head clear as the alcohol burns.

You match Ludo shot-for-shot. He laughs, highly impressed. As he reaches for his glass, his coat swings open, exposing his official exam receipt: **Ludo Castellan - GOLD RANK**. When he notices you looking, he panics and whispers frantically:
"Lyra would kill me if she knew I got Gold and she didn't. She's stuck studying at the library because her exam went terribly. Keep it down, alright? We're good, you didn't see anything."
He downlines his glass and stumbles off to watch the race. You realize he's terrified of his twin sister finding out he scored higher than her. You have some great leverage.

ports.subtext: Go find Val Jr.

blocks.content: You gulp down the grog, but the intense, metallic heat burns your throat. Your head spins, and you take 1 Stress from the sudden wooziness.
Ludo laughs, claps you on the back, and slips away to watch the race. You didn't manage to get much out of him.

ports.subtext: Go find Val Jr.

blocks.content: You head down to the Observatory, where **Valerius Sterling** is broadcasting live commentary on the aether-radio. He is taking wagers from the socialites. He lists the current odds on the race:

- **Shatter Stamper (Team 1)**: 2:1 odds
- **Siren's Wake (Team 2)**: 3:1 odds
- **Pudge (Team 4)**: 4:1 odds

ports.subtext: Wager 10 copper on the dark horse (4:1 odds).
Wager 10 copper on the Ash Reds heavy crawler.
Wager 10 copper on the sleek water racer.

blocks.content: You place 10 copper on Pudge. Valerius nods, writing down your receipt. Since Pudge will go on to win the race, your bet is a winner! You will secure 40 copper when the race finishes.

ports.subtext: Go find Val Jr.

blocks.content: You place 10 copper. Valerius nods, hand-writing your receipt. (Note: You will lose this wager when Pudge wins the race).

ports.subtext: Go find Val Jr.

blocks.content: You walk over to Valentine Jr., who is standing alone in the stateroom corridor looking down at the basalt Ring. He looks up and smiles, relieved to see you:

"I'm glad you're here. I wanted to pick you guys up from the dorms myself, but my father wouldn't let me leave the ship. He sent Ludo instead... who I see is currently enjoying his off-duty status at the bar."

ports.text: Ask Val about the upcoming exam
ports.subtext: Get his thoughts on tomorrow's test.

blocks.content: Val leans in close, lowering his voice:

"Look, you need to be ready. I plan to lock myself in my room to study tonight. My father won't say much, but there is something after the written test though even my father won't tell me what. He's fair if nothing else."

ports.text: Thank Val and promise to keep it secret
ports.subtext: Prepare to rejoin Aunt Angela.

blocks.content: You slip back to Aunt Angela just as the starting horn of the Reszo Race echoes across the canyon basin. The airship engines thrum beneath your feet, and the race begins.
You have the warning. Now you must survive the morning.

ports.subtext: You are ready for Session 8.

blocks.content: You walk alongside your cousin and Aunt Angela, keeping your eyes open. You review the clues you've gathered this week: Serra Vox posing as a commoner and Rill's warning at the bonfire, studying in the courtyard with Pip and Bramble, and securing the VIP passes from Valentine Sterling Jr. in the cafeteria.

The puzzle pieces are coming together, but you must stay alert. Aunt Angela is by far the most bizarre of your elders. You remember the uproar she caused several years ago when she asked if the Forest maybe shouldn't die? It was almost as silly as her asking what lay outside the bounds of the tall Mizizi trees. Whatever she's doing here, she looks decades younger outside the canopy than she looked within.

ports.subtext: Follow Aunt Angela toward the berths.

blocks.content: Angela leads you through the university gates. Ahead, the grand marble pillars of **The Colonnade** frame a stunning view. Crisp white stone and polished brass fixtures catch the sunlight. Through the pillars, you look down into the basalt canyon of the **Apex Ring**.

The fairgrounds outside the canyon are packed. Banners of the racing teams flap in the breeze, and the air is filled with the high-pitched hum of next-gen batteries charging, the heavy thrum of engine blocks warming up, and the shouts of race fans carrying drinks from backpack dispensers.

ports.subtext: Look around for the airship berths.

blocks.content: During the brief pause, Aunt Angela whispers quietly to Aggie:
"Is Britt okay, child? She looks... slouched. Out of breath."
Roll Aggie's Instinct/Insight to evaluate Britt's condition.
You take a close look at Britt. The small fungal growths on her shell are dry, and her breathing is shallow. You don't know this poison, but you know something is wrong with Britt.

ports.subtext: Reveal your worry to the elder.

ports.text: Keep it to yourself and tell a soft lie
ports.subtext: Tell a soft lie while you figure out what's going on.

blocks.content: You examine Britt. She looks sluggish, but given the grueling week, she is likely just exhausted.
"Nothing seems wrong, Auntie. She just hasn't slept much."

ports.subtext: Assure her Britt will recover after a good rest.

blocks.content: Angela frowns, examining Britt's hands.

"I thought she looked strange. She does not look too bad, but I get a strange feeling of deja vu looking at her right now, though I can't place it. I need my books—you must find me in the forest after exams!"

ports.subtext: Ascend onto the VIP airship deck.

blocks.content: Angela takes a long, worried look at Britt's slouched stance:
"Tired, is it? The air in this city is full of noise and the charge of ozone from the buzzing people and technology, child. Keep a close eye on her. If she begins to look pale, let me know."

ports.subtext: Ascend onto the VIP airship deck.

blocks.content: The passenger deck of the Zephyr is relaxed, with well-dressed servants carrying food and drink moving among the guests. You have time to explore before the starting horn sounds. Where do you go?

ports.text: Find Pip and Bramble at the food table
ports.subtext: Join your study group friends for a chat.

ports.text: Meet Aunt Angela in the Observatory
ports.subtext: Walk down to the lower level glass floor.

blocks.content: You spot Pip stuffing sky-bites into her pockets while Bramble sighs, clutching a heavy textbook on structural Mycelium. They look relieved to see a friendly face.

ports.text: Help Pip steal Golden Nectar Truffles
ports.subtext: Finesse/Presence DC 12 to distract the catering staff.
Trade your aero-static guide for his growth paths book.

blocks.content: You step up to talk to the chef, trying to spin a convincing question about the ingredients while Pip sneaks her hand toward the glass platter of Golden Nectar Truffles.

Your distraction works perfectly! Pip grabs the truffles and stuffs them into her mouth. She is so delighted that she playfully throws a pastry at Bramble's head, which misses and hits a nearby servant.
A sudden, chaotic food fight erupts. Ludo Castellan and the other deck staff rush over to break it up, leaving the pathway to the staterooms completely unmonitored. You slip away in the confusion.

ports.subtext: Go find Val Jr.

blocks.content: The chef spots Pip's fingers and yells, swatting her hand away. You are forced to quickly excuse yourselves and flee into the crowd before the servants alert Lord Sterling.
Your cheeks burn with embarrassment, and you take 1 Stress from the close call, but Pip still whispers a quiet, giggling thanks for trying.

ports.subtext: Go find Val Jr.

blocks.content: You swap textbooks with Bramble. He is incredibly relieved to get the aero-static guide, and you get his notes on Mycelium Growth. Reading between his messy handwriting, you unlock the recipe for brewing a **Mycelium Spore-Dampener**.

ports.subtext: Go find Val Jr.

blocks.content: You find Aunt Angela sitting in the Observatory, staring down at the basalt canyon. She looks decades younger than she did back in the forest canopy.
"Stagnation is not saved by death, child! The forest's rules have been corrupted..."
You get the same old rant from Aunt Angela, but this time it feels different—and you tune back in to hear her wrapping up with:
"But don't you dare forget to come see me in the forest after your exams, who knows what will happen to Britt if you don't—or the rest of us!"

ports.text: Ask her about the stagnation rules
ports.subtext: Presence/Instinct DC 12 connection roll to probe further.

blocks.content: Aunt Angela's eyes are wild. You try to press her about what she means by the forest rules being corrupted, connecting with your shared Mizizi heritage.
Angela looks around at the relaxed servants, leans in close, and slips a small, spongy ball of mycelial fibers into your palm.
"Take this, child. If the resonance spikes, crush it. It will ground the feedback loop. Now, off you go—someone is waiting for you."

ports.subtext: Go find Val Jr.

blocks.content: Angela suddenly clamps her mouth shut, looking nervously at a passing servant carrying a platter of glasses. She whispers quickly:
"Too many eyes, child. Go. Do not draw their attention to the forest."
You take 1 Stress from the sudden paranoid tension, feeling the cold weight of the Sterling family's presence on this deck.

ports.subtext: Go find Val Jr.
